name: Théo Marchand
bio: Twelve years behind a booth. Now argues that a good playlist is just a set with the applause taken out.

notes.note: Paris is not all house music, whatever my other lists say. Margot & The Spindles and Lodestar live twenty minutes from me.
Barcelona at seven in the morning, when the clubs let out onto the beach. I go every June and come back with this.
